_meta.note: Pinned versions correspond to ranges returned live by wpvulnerability.net. 'vulnerable' pins target a version inside a recorded vuln range; 'outdated' pins target a patched-but-not-latest version (to exercise the 'outdated version' issue type). If the upstream API changes and a pin stops producing the expected result, the e2e test fails loudly on that component.
